name: Integração Fácil PIX | Easy PIX Integration
author: 4 Feel Technology

sections.description:
Integração Fácil PIX | Easy PIX Integration (free edition) lets your WooCommerce store receive payments with a common PIX key. It shows the QR Code and the Copy-and-Paste (BR Code) string at checkout. Confirmation is manual: the customer pays, sends the receipt to your store, and you mark the order as paid with the effective payment date.

PIX is the Brazilian Central Bank instant payment system. This edition works with any registered PIX key (e-mail, phone, CPF, CNPJ or random key), so no bank or payment service provider integration is needed to start selling.

Features in this edition:

  • Common PIX key: on-screen QR Code and Copy-and-Paste (BR Code) at checkout and in the order e-mail.
  • Manual confirmation by receipt, with “Confirm via WhatsApp” and “Confirm via e-mail” buttons and your store contacts.
  • Shortcode for standalone charges: [integracao_facil_easy_pix_integration amount=”49.90″]
  • Dashboard with period selector (today, 7 days, 30 days, month or custom) and a daily received-amount chart.
  • Reconciliation screen (Transactions) with the effective payment date.
  • Optional PIX discount at checkout.

Not included in this edition (available in the Premium edition):

  • Automatic payment confirmation.
  • Banks and PSPs (Banco Inter, Banco do Brasil, Caixa, Santander, Itaú, Bradesco, Sicoob, Sicredi, C6 Bank, Mercado Pago, Efí and Asaas).
  • Subscriptions / recurring PIX.

The PIX key and all data belong to the store owner; the money goes straight to the owner’s account. This edition makes no external API calls.

Website, support and upgrade: https://agenciamarketing.com.br/plugin-gratis-para-wordpress-integracao-facil-easy-pix-integration
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress: Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload integracao-facil-easy-pix-integration.zip and click Activate.
  3. Open “Integração Fácil PIX | Easy PIX Integration” > Settings.
  4. Fill in your PIX key, the recipient name and the city. Under “Manual confirmation (receipt)”, enter your store e-mail and WhatsApp.

Install only one edition of Integração Fácil PIX | Easy PIX Integration per site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a bank or PSP account?

No. Only your PIX key is required. Payment confirmation is manual.

How do I get automatic confirmation?

With the Premium edition, which integrates banks and PSPs. See the Upgrade tab inside the plugin.

Does it bundle third-party code?

No. The QR Code is generated by a small, self-contained encoder included in the plugin, with no external libraries or services.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Conformidade WordPress.org: scripts e estilos inline movidos para arquivos enfileirados (wp_enqueue / wp_add_inline_style / wp_add_inline_script). Sem mudanca de comportamento.

1.0.3

  • Chaves PIX por tipo: agora e possivel cadastrar uma chave por tipo (e-mail, telefone, CPF, CNPJ e/ou aleatoria). Todas as chaves informadas aparecem na tela do pedido do Venda Facil, cada uma com botao Copiar. O QR Code e o Copia e Cola usam uma unica chave (a definida em “Chave do QR / Copia e Cola”, ou a primeira disponivel).

1.0.2

  • New self-contained QR Code generator (no third-party libraries).
  • Code quality: full compliance pass for the WordPress.org Plugin Check (escaping, script/style enqueueing, i18n and database access).

1.0.1

  • Free edition: common PIX, manual confirmation by receipt, dashboard with period and chart, reconciliation, PIX discount and Upgrade screen.
